materializationRule: Only registered_recovery_missing_file may be materialized automatically, and only when filename plus live executed-statement hash exactly equals the latest valid sealed recovery receipt. Materialization must verify the resulting Git blob identity against that receipt before it is counted as canonical source.
sourceIdentityRule: Git owns canonical source identity. Supabase migration statements own execution history. A sealed executed-statement reconciliation receipt is the only accepted bridge when the two byte representations differ.
activeTailRule: A missing live migration newer than stableRecoveryCutThroughVersion is post_cut_active_tail unless an existing sealed recovery receipt already accounts for it. Active-tail rows are not absorbed into outage recovery automatically.
